title: Sandpiper VPC weekly prep - Priya
content:
Meeting: Sandpiper weekly customer sync (internal prep)
Owner: Priya Shah (lead eng PM)
Attendees expected: Marta (solutions), Diego (installer), Ethan (SRE), Sandpiper infra lead: Rajiv K., Security: Alyssa (rotating)

Objective for this week's sync:
- Lock down L3/L4 routing plan and final CIDR allocations so Sandpiper netops can open firewalls. Need confirmation of 3rd-party appliance IPs.
- Validate installer flow for air-gapped image import (demo happy path).
- Confirm KMS integration timeline and required HSM cert exchange.
- Surface any blockers that would push the GA date > 2026-04-15.

Agenda (10 min prep for us before customer join):
1) Quick status recap (30s each): network, installer, security, SRE
2) Ask: CIDR & NAT details (netops) — we need exact ranges for staging + prod
3) Demo: installer import log + first node bootstrap (5–7 min)
4) Risks & escalations: TLS cert import, offline package checksum failure seen in lab
5) Action items & owners + confirm next checkpoint (date/time)

Key open items / notes to raise explicitly:
- Firewall/IPs: Sandpiper still waiting on appliance vendor to confirm public IPs. Impact: cannot complete egress policy tests. Ask: can they provide temporary NAT ranges? (Owner: Rajiv / Sandpiper)
- KMS/HSM: Security says we need signed CSR from customer HSM vendor for HSM binding. We need to provide CSR template by Fri 3/12. (Owner: Priya -> provide CSR template; Security: Alyssa loop-in)
- Installer checksum mismatch in offline import: Diego traced to tar chunk reassembly for files > 2GB when subnet MTU was dodgy. Workaround: switch to chunked-upload v2 or set MTU 1400. Need to propose both to customer and get their small change approval. (Owner: Diego)
- Cert rotation plan unclear for nodes behind proxy. Ask SRE: do we need to run sidecar re-provisioning? (Owner: Ethan to propose)

Recent changes since last week:
- Canary test in lab passed for 3 node cluster with quantized model; observed increased memory pressure at 48h, SRE investigating oom events. Might require tuning cache eviction.
- Product accepted reduced telemetry retention for onprem customers; Sandpiper asked for additional audit-only logs kept for 90d (legal). We need a compliance exception doc. (Owner: Priya + Legal)

Proposed talking points / phrasing for customer:
- "We can ship a CSR template by EOD Fri. That will unblock the HSM binding step."
- "For the installer checksum item — we have a short-term config workaround and a small fix in the next patch; which cadence do you prefer for patching"
- "We want to confirm CIDR allocations today so we can schedule firewall tests for next Tue."

Action items to capture in meeting (short, owner, due):
- Provide CSR template and sample HSM config (Priya) — due 2026-03-12
- Share temporary NAT CIDR suggestion if vendor delayed (Priya / Rajiv) — due 2026-03-12
- Create runbook snippet for chunked-import workaround + mtune guidance (Diego) — due 2026-03-15
- SRE to propose cert rotation steps for proxied nodes and possible downtime window (Ethan) — due 2026-03-14
- Legal: draft compliance exception for 90d audit logs and review costs (Marta -> Legal) — due 2026-03-18
- Schedule follow-up verification slot with Sandpiper netops for firewall test (Priya) — due 2026-03-13

Escalation notes (if customer blocks on vendor IPs):
- Ask Sales AE to escalate vendor SLA language for public IP disclosure (if >72h delay).
- Open temporary hosted-proxy path as fallback; needs sign-off from Security (Alyssa) and may add cost.

Prep checklist for myself before the call (tick items during meeting):
- [ ] CSR template draft in Confluence link ready
- [ ] Installer logs pre-captured (sandbox: sandpiper-lab-2026-03-10)
- [ ] Short demo run: bootstrap + first-agent registration < 10m (run at 5m mark to be safe)
- [ ] KMS handshake slide + diagram (1 slide)
- [ ] Confirm Diego's workaround wording and impact statement

Notes to capture live (placeholders):
- Firewall vendor ETA: ___________
- CIDR ranges confirmed: ___________
- CSR template feedback: ___________
- Installer error seen on customer's side: ___________

Risks (short):
- High: vendor IP delay -> blocks firewall tests & GA date
- Medium: installer edge-case on large artifacts -> increases time-to-validate
- Low: telemetry retention negotiation -> billing/legal conversation

Timeline (current):
- Target GA: 2026-04-15 (holds if vendor IPs not provided by 3/17)
- Next internal verify window: 2026-03-16 -> need firewall tests completed by 3/15 to run verification

Aftercall follow-up template (to send within 24h):
Subject: Sandpiper weekly sync — notes & action items (from Priya)
Body: short bullets: confirmed CIDRs / outstanding items / owners & due dates / next check-in time + link to runbook + link to Jira ops tickets

Quick personal reminders:
- If they ask for audit logs longer than 90d, push to Legal + Sales to align pricing
- Keep SRE in loop for any node restarts during cert rotation

-- end of prep scratchpad --
